meta.name: requirements-quality
meta.description: Convert product scope into functional requirements, nonfunctional requirements, measurable quality scenarios, acceptance criteria, and traceable requirement links. Use before architecture or implementation when FR/NFR lists, reliability, security, observability, performance, maintainability, compatibility, accessibility, data-safety, or artifacts `11-functional-requirements.md` through `13-quality-scenarios.md` are needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品想法梳理成可验收的需求清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写代码前你需要把产品想法拆成清楚的需求和验收标准。
copy.tagline_en: Turn product ideas into testable requirements and acceptance criteria.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn product ideas into clear requirements before coding.

howto.what: 将产品范围整理成需求清单：功能需求、非功能需求、可度量的质量场景、验收标准和可追溯链接；每条需求会标记类型并与验收标准关联，还会指出矛盾或无法测试的地方。
howto.when: 在架构设计或编码实现之前，当你需要功能/非功能需求列表、可靠性、安全性、可观测性等质量指标，或要生成 `11-functional-requirements.md` 到 `13-quality-scenarios.md` 这类文档时触发。

say.text: 把我们的产品范围转换成功能需求和非功能需求。
say.note: Claude 会按角色和验收标准整理出需求清单。

say.text: 为性能写一个可度量的质量场景。
say.note: 会使用质量场景格式给出可验证的性能指标。

say.text: 检查这些需求是否都有验收标准。
say.note: Claude 会逐条核对并标记缺失项。

howto.what_en: Turns product scope into a requirements list: functional, nonfunctional, quality scenarios, acceptance criteria, and traceable links. Each item is typed and linked to acceptance criteria; contradictions and untestable items are flagged.
howto.when_en: Triggers before architecture or implementation when you need FR/NFR lists, reliability, security, observability, etc., or artifacts like `11-functional-requirements.md` through `13-quality-scenarios.md`.

say_en.text: Turn our product scope into functional and nonfunctional requirements.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a typed requirements list with acceptance criteria.

say_en.text: Write a measurable quality scenario for performance.
say_en.note: Uses the quality scenario format with verifiable metrics.

say_en.text: Check if these requirements all have acceptance criteria.
say_en.note: Claude reviews each item and flags missing ones.
